apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: worker
  namespace: demo
  labels:
    app: worker
    app.kubernetes.io/version: "1.0.0"
  annotations:
    repair.example.dev/source-path: deploy/demo/worker.yaml
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: worker
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: worker
        app.kubernetes.io/version: "1.0.0"
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: worker
          image: python:3.12-alpine3.99
          command: ["python", "/app/worker.py"]
          volumeMounts:
            - name: code
              mountPath: /app
              readOnly: true
          resources:
            requests:
              memory: 32Mi
              cpu: 25m
            limits:
              memory: 64Mi
              cpu: 250m
      volumes:
        - name: code
          configMap:
            name: worker-code
